title: Ashmita Chaliha Stuns World No. 2 Yamaguchi at French Open
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha's victory over the world No. 2 is a significant achievement for Indian badminton on the international stage.
summary: Unseeded Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha created a major upset by defeating world No. 2 and third seed Akane Yamaguchi in straight games at the French Open, securing her spot in the quarterfinals.

title: PV Sindhu Also Reaches French Open Quarterfinals
indian_angle: India's premier shuttler PV Sindhu continues her strong run, joining Ashmita Chaliha in the French Open quarterfinals, boosting India's presence in the tournament.
summary: Alongside Ashmita Chaliha, Indian star PV Sindhu also advanced to the quarterfinals of the French Open badminton tournament, ensuring a strong Indian representation in the later stages.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee provides a crucial platform for Indian players to voice their concerns and contribute to the sport's governance.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to give players a more direct role in decision-making processes and welfare.

title: Junior World Championships Coaching Camp Held in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's young talents for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, nurturing the next generation of Indian badminton stars.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 was conducted at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing India's junior squad.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change will significantly impact how junior domestic tournaments are played in India, potentially influencing player development and match strategies.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
